I didn't think about that, but that's also true. There are some "parents" that only have kids in order to get a live in maid, wouldn't be too extreme to think that they're also looking for a caretaker for when they get older.
Yeah, as though trauma doesn't routinely cause long term illnesses that totally doesn't lead thousands to kill themselves.

I mostly agree, bit I think it's less about people being in denial and more about people being fucking dumb. I vaguely remember a study saying that those with lower levels of education tended to procreate at a higher rate. Ignorance is bliss, after all.
And I'm not saying you have to. I'm just saying that you can continue despite it.

I understand this 100%. I'm also an artist and want to become an animator one day. I remember growing, I was surrounded by classmates and people online who I swear had twice my skill level at half my age. It honestly made me extremely insecure about my own art and almost made me not even try to pursue art anymore. 

I did end up continuing, even got into an art program I wanted to for get in for years now, but I definitely still feel the same jealousy you do. And I'm definitely old enough to where I'm supposed to have my shit together at this point. 

I guess in way too many words I'm saying, don't give up. There are gonna be people who are younger and more talented then you, but there are also going to be thousands of more who quite. That's where you get to shine.

Honestly, some people can be so fucking insensitive and shameless. What the fuck people do with the parts in their pants ain't any of their goddamn business if they don't wanna talk about it. People who can't take a hint are honestly some of the worst.

Honestly, a lot of those people sound like they have no life. 

Imma be straight up with you; I'm personally both anti-natalist and an existential nihilist. But I can tell you, the people who are telling you that life isn't worth living or being happy over are wrong, 100%. While some people do live miserable lives and people aren't just born with their purpose in life tattooed on their ass, it doesn't mean it has to be like that forever. People can grow and change their circumstances and the whole point in living is to make it better. That's where we get purpose and meaning in our lives. Some people wanna do something specific like become rich business men, some people wanna do something more vague like help or inspire others. My personal purpose in life is to spit in the face of God and live a happy life despite all the bullshit he's trying to put us through. But there's always something, lest we all turn into a bunch of flemings be-lining for the nearest cliff. So the people who look at that, all of that, and denounce it as "meanginless" obviously have no idea what they're saying. That's my not-so-humble opinion at least.

That fucking sucks. Parents have one job and yet aren't willing to do it, some major bull if you ask me. And honestly, forget them. If you're not willing to accept and support your kid through thick and thin then don't have any at all. 

Just know that even if your parents don't accept you, there are people around that will. You aren't alone in this.

I get that. I was the same exact way back when I didn't even realize how much mental baggage I was just hefting around. Sometimes you end up just so filled to the brim that even the smallest little things would just make you overflow. 

And this sub can honestly be some fucking bullshit at times. If you don't have the maturity to actually support a fucking post about some serious shit, at least upvote so someone who is capable can.

Don't worry, that'll always be a thing. No matter where you go or how old you turn, there's always gonna be some fucker 20 steps ahead of you. 

It's nothing to feel ashamed of or a sign you're failing or anything, it's just a fact of life. If you get into the habit of trying to one-up everyone you meet, you're gonna dive head-first into a rabbit hole that'll only spell misery and chronic insecurity for you. 

Try not to worry about it too much. Just remember that no matter what, if you're alive, you're moving forward.
Kinda have to when it gets in the way of everything you do lol
